channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLpolitics, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: How extreme weather is shaping tomorrow's electric grid
item.description: Severe heat waves this summer, including one affecting 17 states under federal emergency, are stressing the electric grid.

item.title: The issue CEOs can't afford to ignore
item.description: Data from Brunswick Group and Echelon Insights, chart by Sara Wise/Axios. CEOs face a skeptical American public focused on affordability.

item.title: Fed rates dissenters make their case for higher rates
item.description: Inflation has persisted too long, and the Federal Reserve should not rely on it fading without further action, argue dissenters.

item.title: Exclusive: FBI gets voter's IP address in new fraud probe tactic
item.description: The Trump administration uses IP address tracking to identify potential voter fraud cases among online registrations.
